lines.text: They hadn't qualified. Ten days before kick-off they were in. Three weeks later, champions.
On 31 May 1992, ten days before Euro 92, UEFA confirmed Yugoslavia were out. Denmark took their place.
The beach story is mostly a myth: Denmark already had a friendly against the CIS, and drew it one all.
Michael Laudrup, Denmark's best player, refused to play under coach Richard Møller Nielsen.
Peter Schmeichel saved from Marco van Basten in the semi-final shoot-out: the only miss of the ten.
Kim Vilfort went home to his daughter, who had leukaemia, then came back to score in the final.
Which team in your memory did better because nobody expected anything of them?
